summary.title: 101 Design Patterns & Tips for Developers
summary.one_liner: A categorized index of 101 design patterns and refactoring techniques, each with a one-line description and a link to a longer write-up with code examples.
keywords: java c++ c# php delphi examples
takeaways: Patterns are grouped into creational, structural, and behavioral categories, with a short purpose statement for each.
Refactoring techniques are grouped by goal, such as composing methods, moving features between objects, organizing data, simplifying conditionals, and dealing with generalization.
Each entry gives a brief trigger-and-action rule, for example: extract a code fragment into a well-named method when it can be grouped together.
The page is a navigation index; full descriptions and source code examples are on linked pages (the site states examples in Java, C++, C#, PHP and Delphi).
summary.summary: This page is an index of 101 design patterns and refactoring techniques for developers. It lists the Gang of Four-style creational, structural and behavioral patterns, followed by refactoring techniques grouped by purpose, such as composing methods, moving features between objects, organizing data, simplifying conditionals and dealing with generalization. Each item has a one-sentence summary and a "more" link to a detailed article. The text shown is mostly the summaries, so the page works as a quick reference rather than a full tutorial.
